summary: Appends a fixed prompt prefix and advances the deletion boundary to protect it from backspace.

name: HUlib_clearTextLine
summary: Clears hUlib clear Text Line state before the next heads-up display update.

name: HUlib_delCharFromIText
summary: Deletes one input byte only when it lies after the protected prefix boundary.

name: HUlib_delCharFromTextLine
summary: Removes the final byte from a nonempty HUD line, restores termination, and schedules redraws.

name: HUlib_drawIText
summary: Draws a visible editable line with the cursor glyph placed after its current text.

name: HUlib_drawSText
summary: Draws visible stack lines newest-first by walking backward through the circular buffer.

name: HUlib_drawTextLine
summary: Renders a HUD text buffer with patch-font glyph widths, optional cursor, spaces, and right-edge clipping.

name: HUlib_eraseIText
summary: Erases a dirty input line, forcing redraws when its externally controlled visibility turns off.

name: HUlib_eraseLineFromIText
summary: Removes all editable input while retaining the protected prefix bytes.

name: HUlib_eraseSText
summary: Marks lines dirty on visibility transitions, erases every stack line, and remembers the current visibility state.

name: HUlib_eraseTextLine
summary: Restores border regions covered by a dirty HUD line and decrements its multi-frame redraw counter.

name: HUlib_init
summary: Preserves the original HUD-library initialization hook; this implementation has no module-wide resources to allocate.

name: HUlib_initIText
summary: Creates an editable HUD line, clears its protected-prefix boundary, and attaches its visibility reference.

name: HUlib_initSText
summary: Builds a fixed-height circular message stack whose lines are vertically spaced from the font height.

name: HUlib_initTextLine
summary: Assigns position and font metadata, allocates a bounded text buffer, and marks a HUD line dirty.

name: HUlib_keyInIText
summary: Applies printable, backspace, or enter input to an editable HUD line and reports whether the key was consumed.

name: HUlib_resetIText
summary: Clears hUlib reset IText state before the next heads-up display update.

name: I_AllocLow
summary: Allocates a zeroed byte buffer for legacy callers that expect low-memory storage.

name: I_BaseTiccmd
summary: Returns a reusable zeroed tic-command record that platform input code may populate for the current game tic.

name: I_BeginHDWipe
summary: Captures the current high-resolution start frame from OpenGL, the last RGBA frame, or a nearest logical fallback.

name: I_BeginRead
summary: Preserves the legacy disk-read activity hook; this backend requires no begin notification.

name: I_CaptureGLFrameToScreen
summary: Composes the current OpenGL world and UI, then reads a logical indexed capture into screen zero.

name: I_CaptureLogicalOverlayBase
summary: Captures the logical framebuffer before late menu/message drawing.

name: I_EndRead
summary: Preserves the legacy disk-read activity hook; this backend requires no end notification.

name: I_Error
summary: Performs one-shot fatal shutdown, prints the diagnostic, releases subsystems, and terminates with a nonzero exit code.

name: I_FinishUpdate
summary: Presents one completed frame through native OpenGL, indexed GL fallback, or GDI and performs FPS/screenshot bookkeeping.

name: I_GetEvent
summary: Pumps native messages and posts all currently observed keyboard and mouse input changes.

name: I_GetFPS
summary: Exposes the last completed one-second presentation sample to in-game UI overlays.

name: I_GetHeapSize
summary: Converts the configured zone-heap size from mebibytes to bytes.

name: I_GetSfxLumpNum
summary: Resolves an SFX metadata name to its `DS*` lump, falling back to the pistol sound when absent.

name: I_GetTime
summary: Converts elapsed Win32 milliseconds since the first call into whole 35 Hz game tics.

name: I_GetTimeFrac
summary: Returns the clamped fractional progress through the current 35 Hz tic for uncapped interpolation.

name: I_HandleSoundTimer
summary: Preserves the legacy timer callback hook; WinMM/MUS advancement is driven by the main update loop.

name: I_HDScreenWipe
summary: Advances, draws, and swaps the high-resolution melt transition, returning true after every column reaches the bottom.

name: I_Init
summary: Brings up the platform audio backend after core engine globals are available.

name: I_InitGraphics
summary: Allocates video/input buffers, parses display and screenshot options, creates the window, and initializes presentation state.

name: I_InitMusic
summary: Clears song registration/playback state, opens MIDI output, and applies the default master volume.

name: I_InitNetwork
summary: Resets doomcom and tic queues to deterministic single-player defaults before any MP role starts.

name: I_InitSound
summary: Initializes SFX caches/tables/channels, opens waveform output, and starts the MIDI music backend.

name: I_LoadingPulse
summary: Pumps window/audio updates and draws an animated loading marker while heavy loading code runs.

name: I_NetCmd
summary: Executes one Doom CMD_GET/CMD_SEND operation through the validated platform packet queue.

name: I_PauseSong
summary: Pauses the active registered song, resets sounding MIDI notes, and updates its slot flags.

name: I_PlaySong
summary: Resolves a registered song, validates/starts its MUS stream, and records requested looping state.

name: I_PollInput
summary: Pumps native messages and posts current keyboard and mouse edge/motion events to Doom.

name: I_PrecacheSfx
summary: Decodes one SFX id into the rate/sample cache before first playback.

name: I_PrepareHDWipeEnd
summary: Captures the destination frame and initializes correlated delayed melt positions for two-logical-pixel column groups.

name: I_QrySongPlaying
summary: Reports whether the requested handle is the active, unpaused MUS song.

name: I_Quit
summary: Leaves the netgame, closes platform, audio, and graphics services, saves defaults, then exits successfully.

name: I_ReadScreen
summary: Copies the complete 320x200 logical framebuffer from screen zero into a caller-provided capture buffer.

name: I_RegisterSong
summary: Stores immutable MUS bytes under a new handle with initial stopped/non-looping metadata.

name: I_ResumeSong
summary: Resumes the active paused song from its MUS cursor with a rebased wall-clock timestamp.

name: I_SetChannels
summary: Rebuilds the pitch table if needed and resets all software mixing channels.

name: I_SetForceSoftwarePresent
summary: Forces the next presentation path to use a nearest-scaled logical framebuffer instead of native OpenGL world output.

name: I_SetLoadingStatus
summary: Sets or clears loading text in the window caption, resets animation when cleared, and pumps messages immediately.

name: I_SetMusicVolume
summary: Normalizes Doom music volume and applies it to both WinMM MIDI output channels.

name: I_SetPalette
summary: Applies the selected gamma table to a 256-color palette and updates both GDI and OpenGL palette consumers.

name: I_SetSfxVolume
summary: Normalizes and stores the master SFX gain used when starting/mixing effects.

name: I_ShutdownGraphics
summary: Restores the cursor, shuts down OpenGL, releases the device context, and destroys the owned native window.

name: I_ShutdownMusic
summary: Stops the active MUS score and resets/closes the platform MIDI backend.

name: I_ShutdownSound
summary: Stops SFX, releases waveform buffers/device state, and shuts down registered MIDI music.

name: I_SoundDelTimer
summary: Clears the legacy sound-timer enabled flag during backend teardown.

name: I_SoundIsPlaying
summary: Reports whether a sound handle still owns an active channel with unread PCM samples.

name: I_SoundSetTimer
summary: Marks the legacy sound timer enabled while ignoring its obsolete tick-period argument.

name: I_StartFrame
summary: Services native window messages at the start of a rendered frame.

name: I_StartSound
summary: Loads an SFX, derives its pitch step, assigns a mixing channel, and returns a public playback handle.

name: I_StartTic
summary: Polls and posts platform input events at the start of a simulation tic.

name: I_StopSong
summary: Stops the active song decoder or clears only the metadata flags of a different registered handle.

name: I_StopSound
summary: Deactivates the software mixing channel associated with a public sound handle.

name: I_SubmitSound
summary: Fills every currently free WinMM ring slot with a freshly mixed PCM block.

name: I_Tactile
summary: Accepts legacy force-feedback parameters; this backend deliberately performs no tactile output.

name: I_UnRegisterSong
summary: Stops a matching active song and removes its handle/data record from the registration table.

name: I_UpdateNoBlit
summary: Services the Win32 message queue without presenting or modifying a framebuffer.

name: I_UpdateSound
summary: Advances wall-clock-driven MUS/MIDI playback during the engine sound update.

name: I_UpdateSoundParams
summary: Recomputes pitch step and stereo gains for an active sound handle.

name: I_WaitVBL
summary: Sleeps for the requested number of 70 Hz vertical-blank intervals using millisecond platform timing.

name: I_ZoneBase
summary: Allocates the requested zone heap, reports its actual size through the reference argument, and retains the buffer for engine-wide lifetime.

name: IdentifyVersion
summary: Selects the IWAD, game mode, language, and mission family before resource initialization.

name: igl_active
summary: Tracks whether igl active is active in the i gl subsystem.

name: igl_base_palette

name: P_ActivateInStasis
summary: Resumes tagged platforms in stasis by restoring their previous status and movement callback.

name: P_ActivateInStasisCeiling
summary: Resumes every stopped ceiling matching a trigger tag by restoring its saved direction.

name: P_AddActiveCeiling
summary: Places a ceiling mover in the first free active slot so tagged stop and resume events can find it.

name: P_AddActivePlat
summary: Places a platform mover in the first free active slot, failing explicitly when the fixed table is exhausted.

name: P_AddThinker
summary: Adds thinker entries to the play simulation.

name: P_AimLineAttack
summary: Computes line attack values for the map collision.

name: P_AllocateThinker
summary: Constructs an unlinked thinker node with an empty callback and owner slot.

name: P_AproxDistance
summary: Computes Doom's inexpensive fixed-point distance approximation from horizontal and vertical deltas.

name: P_ArchivePlayers
summary: Writes the active-player mask followed by one versioned player record for each participating slot.

name: P_ArchiveSpecials
summary: Serializes supported active ceiling, door, floor, platform, lighting, and button thinkers with sector references and terminates the list.

name: P_ArchiveThinkers
summary: Counts serializable mobj thinkers and emits a versioned typed thinker section containing each validated owner.

name: P_ArchiveWorld
summary: Serializes mutable sector heights, textures, light, specials, and sidedef texture/offset state in map-array order.

name: P_BlockLinesIterator
summary: Visits each valid line in one blockmap cell once per traversal and stops immediately when the callback rejects it.

name: P_BlockThingsIterator
summary: Walks the mobj chain for one blockmap cell and stops when the callback returns false.

name: P_BoxOnLineSide
summary: Classifies an axis-aligned bounding box against a line, returning -1 when the box straddles both sides.

name: P_BringUpWeapon
summary: Commits the pending weapon, lowers its sprite origin to WEAPONBOTTOM, clears flash state, and enters its raise state.

name: P_BulletSlope
summary: Computes the shared hitscan auto-aim slope, retrying slightly right and left when the forward trace finds no target.

name: P_CalcHeight
summary: Derives weapon bob and eye height from horizontal momentum, stance, airborne state, and ceiling clearance.

name: P_CalcSwing
summary: Computes fixed-point weapon sway from player bob amplitude and level-time sine phases.

name: P_ChangeSector
summary: Visits all blockmap things touching a moving sector and reports whether any were crushed.

name: P_ChangeSwitchTexture
summary: Finds the activated sidedef texture's paired switch image, plays its sound, and optionally schedules restoration.

name: P_CheckAmmo
summary: Verifies the ready weapon's per-shot ammo cost or selects a usable fallback and starts lowering the empty weapon.

name: P_CheckMeleeRange
summary: Requires a live target within radius-adjusted melee distance, modest vertical separation, and line of sight.

name: P_CheckMissileRange
summary: Applies sight, reaction, distance, melee-capability, and randomized aggression rules before a monster fires.

name: P_CheckMissileSpawn
summary: Advances a new missile half a tic and explodes it immediately if its initial position is blocked.

name: P_CheckPosition
summary: Probes a candidate origin, populating shared opening globals without committing the mobj position.

name: P_CheckSight
summary: Rejects impossible sector pairs early, then traces BSP portals and vertical slopes to decide whether two mobjs see each other.

name: P_CrossBSPNode
summary: Traverses the BSP front-to-back along the sight trace, stopping as soon as either child proves occlusion.

name: P_CrossSpecialLine
summary: Dispatches one-shot and repeatable walkover specials after validating line index, side, actor, and projectile rules.

name: P_CrossSubsector
summary: Clips the sight slope window against every blocking seg in a subsector and rejects fully occluded traces.

name: P_DamageMobj
summary: Applies armor, thrust, pain, death, and attacker attribution for one damage event.

name: P_DeathThink
summary: Lowers the dead player's view, turns toward the attacker, and requests rebirth when use is pressed.

name: P_DivlineSide
summary: Classifies a point against a divline, returning two for an exact collinear hit and using scaled products to avoid overflow.

name: P_DropWeapon
summary: Starts the ready weapon's lowering state, typically during death or an explicit switch.

name: P_ExplodeMissile
summary: Stops missile momentum, enters its death state, removes missile solidity, and plays its death cue.

name: P_FindHighestCeilingSurrounding
summary: Returns the maximum ceiling height among all valid sectors adjacent to the supplied sector.

name: P_FindHighestFloorSurrounding
summary: Returns the maximum floor height among all valid sectors adjacent to the supplied sector.

name: P_FindLowestCeilingSurrounding
summary: Returns the minimum ceiling height among all valid sectors adjacent to the supplied sector.

name: P_FindLowestFloorSurrounding
summary: Returns the minimum floor height among all valid sectors adjacent to the supplied sector.

name: P_FindMinSurroundingLight
summary: Finds the lowest adjacent sector light level without exceeding the caller-provided starting maximum.

name: P_FindNextHighestFloor
summary: Returns the lowest adjacent floor strictly above currentheight, or currentheight when none exists.

name: P_FindSectorFromLineTag
summary: Continues a linear search after start for the next sector whose tag matches the triggering line.

name: P_FindSlidingDoorType
summary: Computes sliding door type values for the play simulation.

name: P_FireWeapon
summary: After an ammo check, enters attack states and alerts nearby monsters unless persistent notarget is active.

name: P_ForgetPlayerTarget
summary: Makes active monsters and sector sound emitters immediately forget one newly hidden player.

name: P_GiveAmmo
summary: Adds clip-scaled ammunition, clamps capacity, and selects a newly usable weapon.

name: P_GiveArmor
summary: Replaces armor only when the requested class provides more effective points.

name: P_GiveBody
summary: Heals a player and mirrors the clamped health into the owned mobj.

name: P_GiveCard
summary: Grants a key/card once and triggers the pickup flash.

name: P_GivePower
summary: Grants or refreshes a player powerup while respecting permanent berserk strength.

name: P_GiveWeapon
summary: Applies Doom coop/deathmatch weapon-stay and ammo pickup rules.

name: P_GroupLines
summary: Assigns subsector sectors and builds each sector's line list, fixed bounds, blockmap bounds, and centered sound origin.

name: P_GunShot
summary: Fires one randomized-damage hitscan at the cached bullet slope, adding horizontal spread unless accurate is true.

name: P_HitSlideLine
summary: Projects the pending slide vector along the wall axis or clears it on horizontal/vertical walls.

name: P_Init
summary: Prepares switch pairs, animated flats/textures, and sprite definitions shared by all subsequently loaded levels.

name: P_InitPicAnims
summary: Resolves built-in flat/texture animation name ranges, validates contiguity, and records runtime frame cycles.

name: P_InitSlidingDoorFrames
summary: Resets the sliding-door frame table before map or renderer-specific frames are registered.

name: P_InitSwitchList
summary: Resolves texture pairs allowed by the current game edition and terminates the list with a sentinel.

name: P_InitThinkers
summary: Resets the thinker sentinel into an empty circular doubly linked list and clears owner bookkeeping.

name: P_InterceptVector
summary: Computes the fixed-point fraction where one divline intersects another, returning zero for parallel traces.

name: P_InterceptVector2
summary: Computes where the current sight trace intersects a partition line as a fixed-point fraction.

name: P_KillMobj
summary: Finalizes an actor death, including Doom frag semantics, corpse state, drops, and player rebirth state.

name: P_LineAttack
summary: Configures a hitscan ray and traverses intercepts to apply damage at the supplied slope.

name: P_LineOpening
summary: Computes the vertical opening, top, bottom, and low-floor values across a two-sided line into shared trace globals.

name: P_LoadBlockMap
summary: Decodes BLOCKMAP words, promotes its origin, normalizes cell offsets, and allocates empty per-cell thing chains.

name: P_LoadLineDefs
summary: Decodes LINEDEFS, resolves vertices and sectors, and precomputes direction, slope class, and bounding boxes.

name: P_LoadNodes
summary: Decodes BSP partition origins, directions, child bounds, and node-or-subsector child identifiers.

name: P_LoadSectors
summary: Decodes SECTORS records, resolves flat names, and initializes mutable sound, thing, line, and special ownership fields.

name: P_LoadSegs
summary: Decodes SEGS geometry and resolves its linedef, sidedef, front sector, and optional opposite sector links.

name: P_LoadSideDefs
summary: Decodes SIDEDEFS offsets and texture names, then resolves each record's owning sector reference.

name: P_LoadSubsectors
summary: Decodes SSECTORS seg ranges while leaving sector ownership for the later line-grouping pass.

name: P_LoadThings
summary: Decodes THINGS records and spawns edition-compatible map objects, stopping at unsupported commercial actors in noncommercial games.

name: P_LoadVertexes
summary: Decodes four-byte VERTEXES records and promotes map-unit coordinates to fixed-point runtime vertices.

name: P_LookForPlayers
summary: Cycles active living players, enforcing field-of-view unless allaround, and acquires the first visible target.

name: P_MakeDivline
summary: Copies a linedef's first vertex and direction into the lightweight divline form used by trace calculations.

name: P_MobjThinker
summary: Advances one actor's movement/state timer and triggers nightmare respawn when eligible.

name: P_Move
summary: Attempts one movedir step, adjusts floating monsters, and activates crossed special lines when blocked.

name: P_MovePlayer
summary: Applies command turning and grounded forward/side thrust, then enters the run animation when movement is requested.

name: P_MovePsprites
summary: Advances weapon/flash state tics and keeps the flash layer aligned to the weapon sprite.

name: P_NewChaseDir
summary: Chooses diagonal or cardinal movement toward the target while avoiding immediate turnaround and blocked directions.

name: P_NightmareRespawn
summary: Recreates a killed monster at its original spawn point with teleport fog and reaction delay.

name: P_NoiseAlert
summary: Starts a new sound-validity flood from the emitter's sector so monsters acquire target as their sound target.

name: P_PathTraverse
summary: Steps a trace through blockmap cells, collects requested line and thing crossings, sorts them by fraction, and invokes the traverser in order.

name: p_picanim_revision
summary: Tracks the mutable p picanim revision value used by the p spec subsystem.

name: P_PlayerInSpecialSector
summary: Applies floor-contact damage, secret discovery, and exit effects for the player's current sector special.

name: P_PlayerThink
summary: Applies one tic command to player movement, view, weapon, use, power timers, and death or live-state transitions.

name: P_PointOnDivlineSide
summary: Classifies a fixed-point point against an infinite divline using overflow-safe sign tests and scaled cross products.

name: P_PointOnLineSide
summary: Classifies a fixed-point point against a partition line while preserving Doom's vertical, horizontal, and sign-bit shortcuts.

name: P_RadiusAttack
summary: Walks blast-radius blockmap cells and damages visible shootable occupants around an explosion.

name: P_Random
summary: Advances and returns the deterministic gameplay random-table stream used by demo-synchronized simulation.

name: P_RecursiveSound
summary: Floods a noise target through open two-sided sectors, crossing at most one sound-blocking line.

name: P_RegisterThinkerOwner
summary: Associates a thinker node with its owning gameplay object in the fallback owner registry.

name: P_RemoveActiveCeiling
summary: Clears the slot holding a completed ceiling mover so it no longer participates in tagged control.

name: P_RemoveActivePlat
summary: Clears a completed platform's sector ownership, removes its thinker, and frees its active slot.

name: P_RemoveMobj
summary: Queues eligible specials for respawn, unlinks the actor, and unregisters its thinker safely.

name: P_RemoveThinker
summary: Removes remove Thinker data from the play simulation system.

name: P_ResolveThinkerOwner
summary: Returns a thinker's direct owner or resolves it from the fallback registry used by legacy nodes.

name: P_RespawnSpecials
summary: Respawns one queued pickup after its delay when the destination is unoccupied.

name: P_RunFrozenPlayerMobjs
summary: Advances only active player mobjs while the developer freeze suspends every other world thinker.

name: P_RunThinkers
summary: Walks the thinker list safely across removals and invokes each active callback with its resolved owner.

name: P_SetMobjState
summary: Enters a state, runs its action, and follows zero-tic transitions until a timed or null state.

name: P_SetPsprite
summary: Enters a player-sprite state, applies offsets and actions, and immediately follows zero-tic transitions until stable or null.

name: P_SetThingPosition
summary: Finds a thing's subsector and links it into sector and blockmap lists unless its flags suppress either index.

name: P_SetupLevel
summary: Tears down prior level state, loads map lumps in dependency order, links geometry, spawns actors/specials, precaches assets, and enters GS_LEVEL.

name: P_SetupPsprites
summary: Clears both player-sprite layers and initializes the ready weapon through the normal bring-up transition.

name: P_ShootSpecialLine
summary: Dispatches gun-triggered line types to floor, door, or switch actions while enforcing monster restrictions.

name: P_SlideMove
summary: Traces leading corners, clips momentum at the nearest wall, and retries up to three slide bumps.

name: P_SpawnBlood
summary: Spawns a randomized blood spray and selects its damage-scaled animation state.

name: P_SpawnDoorCloseIn30
summary: Attaches a countdown thinker that closes an initially open sector door after 30 seconds.

name: P_SpawnDoorRaiseIn5Mins
summary: Attaches a delayed thinker that opens the sector door once after five minutes.

name: P_SpawnFireFlicker
summary: Attaches a fire-flicker thinker using the sector's current light as maximum and its darkest neighbor as minimum.

name: P_SpawnGlowingLight
summary: Attaches a glow thinker that begins dimming from the sector's current light toward its darkest neighbor.

name: P_SpawnLightFlash
summary: Attaches a randomized two-level flash thinker bounded by the sector's original and darkest neighboring light.

name: P_SpawnMapThing
summary: Filters a mapthing by player/skill/type rules, then spawns its actor and map-derived flags.

name: P_SpawnMissile
summary: Aims a projectile from source to destination, sets owner/momentum, and validates its first step.

name: P_SpawnMobj
summary: Instantiates an actor from mobjinfo, links it spatially, and registers its thinker ownership.

name: P_SpawnPlayer
summary: Converts a player start mapthing into a live pawn and attaches view, health, and reborn state.

name: P_SpawnPlayerMissile
summary: Auto-aims a player projectile across fallback angles before spawning and validating it.

name: P_SpawnPuff
summary: Spawns a randomized-height bullet puff and selects its melee-safe animation variant.

name: P_SpawnSpecials
summary: Parses the level timer, spawns sector lighting/door effects, collects scrolling lines, and resets active movers/buttons.

name: P_SpawnStrobeFlash
summary: Attaches a fast or slow strobe thinker, optionally synchronizing its initial countdown with peer sectors.

name: P_StartButton
summary: Reserves a timer for a reusable switch texture, avoiding duplicate records for the same linedef.

name: P_TeleportMove
summary: Telefrags destination occupants and relocates the mobj without ordinary wall/step restrictions.

name: P_ThingHeightClip
summary: Recomputes floor/ceiling bounds after sector motion and clamps a grounded mobj to its new floor.

name: P_Thrust
summary: Projects a movement magnitude through fine-angle sine/cosine tables and adds it to player horizontal momentum.

name: P_Ticker
summary: Advances players, thinkers, and sector specials once per unpaused game tic, then increments level time.

name: P_TouchSpecialThing
summary: Resolves one pickup collision, mutates authoritative inventory, and removes consumable actors.

name: P_TraverseIntercepts
summary: Computes intercepts values for the map utility.

name: P_TryMove
summary: Validates step/dropoff/ceiling constraints and commits a legal XY move with sector relinking.

name: P_TryWalk
summary: Performs one monster move and randomizes the number of tics before its next chase-direction choice.

name: P_UnArchivePlayers
summary: Reads active player records for the detected save version and resets inactive slots to canonical defaults.

name: P_UnArchiveSpecials
summary: Recreates serialized special thinkers, reconnects their sector ownership, and rebuilds active ceiling/platform registries.

name: P_UnArchiveThinkers
